question: By whom was the teaching concerning the earth-moving yoginīs transmitted?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-moving yoginīs
They are described as good eaters
inference: The teaching about the earth-moving yoginīs was told by an earth-mover
uncertainties: The form bhūcarī as instrumental singular is unusual and may reflect textual variation
plain_english: O beloved, it was told by an earth-mover concerning the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs.
